metadata.description: Occupational-stress questionnaire on work effort, rewards, and overcommitment.
metadata.intended_use: Occupational health, work-stress research, and psychosocial risk assessment.
metadata.name_origin: Effort-Reward Imbalance model and questionnaire, abbreviated ERI.
metadata.development_history: Developed from the sociological effort-reward imbalance model of work stress.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Stress risk increases when high effort is not matched by adequate esteem, salary, promotion, or job security.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Use the exact German form and ratio/scoring rules; it describes work conditions and does not diagnose burnout or depression.

versions.source_citation: Siegrist (1996). Adverse health effects of high-effort/low-reward conditions.
